response.overview: To dispute an Xfinity charge over the phone, call +1 866 465 1426 with your statement date and exact fee amount, or upload your return receipts through get help. Ask the billing dispute specialist to place an active dispute hold on the line item so late fees stop while the credit posts.  Dialing +1 866 465 1426 skips basic phone queues that cannot resolve automatic self-install tech conversions and unlinked hardware returns. Once connected with billing dispute specialists, a live specialist checks your account and starts the fix on the same call.  Removing invalid technician and equipment charges  You can contact +1 866 465 1426 to get support whenever you run into unexpected installation fees, unreturned-gear charges, or unknown add-ons.
